note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written in our own words for this entry; each one names its sources. Hidden means PlayStation hides the trophy until it is earned. Count is the total PlayStation tracks for the trophy, where it tracks one.

trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game. The platinum pops automatically the moment the 54th trophy unlocks, so there is nothing extra to do for it on its own. Expect a long road: launch-era guides put the platinum at roughly 200 hours, with the 100% completion checklist the biggest single chunk of that time.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission of the game and unlocks as you play, so you cannot miss it. The trophy usually pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play through the opening chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapter trophies can pop as the next chapter begins rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it is a few seconds late. Nothing optional is needed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Finish every story mission in the chapter in order. This is also the chapter where switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, right after the mission Breakfast Run, so most of the open-world list becomes available from here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep playing the story missions in order. One warning for this chapter: the race against Yago in the street racing strand is time-sensitive (it carries an hourglass icon) and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so do that race the moment it appears and save first.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish the chapter's story missions. The optional bank-vault mission That's Where The Money Is appears near the end of this chapter and opens the bank-vault robberies, so take it when it shows up rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the last story mission of Chapter 5 and watch the credits. Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your only way back if you want to redo anything in the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. This Chapter 2 story mission is the one that opens switching between Jason and Lucia, so it unlocks early in the chapter as you play through the story. Just finish the mission.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story mission: play through it in order and the trophy pops at the end. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. A story mission: finish it and the trophy pops. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. A story mission: finish it and the trophy pops. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. A story mission set at Vice City International Airport: finish it and the trophy pops. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A story mission: finish it and the trophy pops. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The 100% checklist is a 35-task list that only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but work you do earlier still counts, so there is no need to wait before starting it. The list covers the story, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, and the collectibles. It is the longest grind in the game and the last trophy most players earn.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the total, so mix them up as you travel instead of hunting one type. Keep going after 250: the 100% checklist needs 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types across Leonida: play one of each (races, shooting range, fishing, bowling, arcade games, drone races, gym, meditation and the rest) and the trophy pops. It is a taster trophy: you only need one try at each, not a win.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them: gold every challenge at both. Take your time and learn each challenge's pattern first; gold is about accuracy and speed, not firepower, so a steady aim beats spraying.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations across Leonida: win at least one race at each. Learn a course on a practice run first, then go for the win; the tight corners punish a full-throttle line.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count: street races, boat and bike races included. You do not need to win the same race twice, so spread out across Leonida's race scene instead of repeating one favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Fishing is one of the game's side activities: take it slow, watch the line tension, and reel in steadily rather than yanking.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts: pick one and play it through to the end. Arcades are found around Vice City, so this is a quick trophy once you spot a cabinet.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand, a series of optional stranger missions, and finish its last mission. Side-story finales stay available after the credits, so there is no rush and nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's mission strand and finish its last mission. Like the other side finales, it stays open after the story ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work through Billy's mission strand and finish its last mission. Side finales remain available in free roam after the credits.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to see which ones counted. One warning: the Chapter 3 race against Yago in the street racing strand is time-sensitive (it carries an hourglass icon), so do it the moment it appears and save first.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's mission strand and finish its last mission. Side finales stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's mission strand and finish its last mission. Side finales stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in total. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. THIS IS THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN MISS: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house is only available in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, check the kitchen in the morning and follow her out to the balcony, then accept the optional task. It disappears once Chapter 1 ends, and whether it is strictly required is still unconfirmed, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what Bret wants, so take the shot from cover and do not rush it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find the collectible cards scattered across Leonida and finish three full sets. Cards are a pure collectible hunt: work through them region by region and use the in-game map markers so you do not backtrack.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to tag 100 different locations across Leonida. Tag as you travel and the count climbs on its own: it pairs well with exploring for The Goodtime State, so do the two together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges: 50 of them for this trophy, and the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80. Many complete on their own while you play, so open the list and mop up the easy ones (driving, combat, exploration) in free roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The easiest way is a bank vault job: vaults give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away. Bring your partner, finish the vault, then lose the cops together. The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks, so keep moving and keep the heat on. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive: variety matters more than speed. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus, giving you more time for all five.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge: the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos: get into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it: kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, take its cargo and lose the heat. It pairs naturally with the bank-vault work: armored trucks are the same security vans you tail for the vault jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: visit all 52 areas of the map. The areas reveal as you travel, so take a slow drive through each region, Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the countryside, and the map fills out. It pairs well with WAiNK tagging for You WAiNKer!, so do the two together.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are nine gangs: rob one illegal operation from each. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way to that.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger was still unconfirmed at launch: the description points to having a drink somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach, so try the beachfront bars and cocktail spots along Ocean Drive and watch for the pop. If it does not trigger, it may be tied to a specific story moment; check back as launch-era guides confirm it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact trigger was still unconfirmed at launch: the description points to driving a car straight through a vehicle showroom's frontage, GTA-style, rather than using the door. Try a showroom in Vice City with a fast car and a clear run-up; if it does not pop, it may need a specific showroom or story beat.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you: bench, weights and the rest until both of you max out.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind as you work through the rest of the list: just keep playing and check the counter now and then.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact trigger was still unconfirmed at launch: the name and description point to failing something and then succeeding on the second try, so it likely pops from an ordinary second attempt at a mission, race or challenge. Play normally and it should come on its own; do not chase it early.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The exact trigger was still unconfirmed at launch: the description points to witnessing something strange, so it likely pops from a random or hidden event somewhere in Leonida, the kind of odd encounter the series is known for. Keep exploring off the beaten path and it should find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle: a melee drive-by. Pick a slow stretch of road with pedestrians, equip a melee weapon, and swing as you roll past.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds up across the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop: clothes, weapons, food, cars and the rest, so it climbs as you play. Big purchases (vehicles, weapons) move it fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count: only the ones you buy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
